definitions.default: Platform-reported value; see the platform column for its source.
definitions.stars: GitHub stargazers. Interest signal, not discovery.
definitions.forks: GitHub forks. Code-reuse intent, not users.
definitions.open_issues: Open GitHub issues, excluding pull requests.
definitions.open_prs: Open GitHub pull requests, including bots.
definitions.external_contributions: Open issues/PRs by humans other than the owner.
definitions.external_issues: Open issues by humans other than the owner.
definitions.apk_downloads: GitHub release APK asset download counter. Downloads, not installs.
definitions.all_asset_downloads: Every release asset download on GitHub, including non-APK files.
definitions.releases: Published GitHub releases returned by the API.
definitions.downloads: Platform-reported Freebuff downloads from a dated human observation.
definitions.score: Reddit post score, which Reddit fuzzes intentionally.
definitions.comments: Comment count reported by the platform.
definitions.posts_found: Tracked posts that returned data in this run.
definitions.submissions: Hacker News stories matched to Pipo by the relevance filter.
definitions.points: Sum of Hacker News story points across matched submissions.
definitions.rating: Product Hunt review rating, where present.
definitions.indexed_documents: Document count reported by XERJ itself; no schema is documented.
definitions.surfaces_up: Configured public URLs answering with HTTP 2xx/3xx.
definitions.listing_live: 1 when f-droid.org serves the package page (HTTP 200), else 0.
definitions.package_page_status: HTTP status of the f-droid.org package page.
definitions.pipeline_jobs: Jobs created in the latest F-Droid MR pipeline.
definitions.mr_comments: Comments on the F-Droid merge request.
definitions.metadata_checks_passed: Local structural checks that passed for the submitted metadata.
